scope: Command and shared-control catalog coverage only. Check references locate tests or implementation for review; they do not establish execution or prove that every command, native workflow, visual state, or performance requirement has passed.

ios.fullscreen: The installed UIKit SDK offers scene orientation requests, but no native iPad window full-screen toggle. This capability remains open; Mac Catalyst's geometry API does not apply to this UIKit target.
